data.notes: July 2026 is unusually strong for Tokyo-area arena and stadium pop, with confirmed anime-song festivals, idol/franchise live events, and international R&B headliners already on sale or announced.

events.title: Mrs. GREEN APPLE: ZENJIN MITO TO IM/MUTABLE ~Interlude~
events.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE close their stadium run with two Tokyo dates at MUFG Stadium on July 4 and July 5, both opening at 16:30 and starting at 18:30. The official tour page lists the National Stadium schedule and SOGO TOKYO inquiry details.

events.title: Animelo Summer Live 2026 -Messenger-
events.summary: Animelo Summer Live 2026 runs July 10–12 at Makuhari Messe in Chiba, with artists including SHOUTA AOI, angela, fripSide, GRANRODEO, TrySail, MYTH & ROID, Umamusume: Pretty Derby, CHiCO with HoneyWorks, and ReoNa. The official English site bills ANISAMA as a major anime-song music event and lists daily lineups and start times.

events.title: SOUL CAMP 2026
events.summary: SOUL CAMP returns after seven years at SGC Hall Ariake on July 4. The official site confirms Erykah Badu as headliner for an exclusive live-band performance, with more artists to be announced.

events.title: OFFICIAL HIGE DANDISM one-man tour 2026
events.summary: Official HIGE DANdism are confirmed for K-Arena Yokohama on July 25 and July 26, with the venue schedule listing 18:00 starts. K-Arena’s official event pages confirm the artist, dates, and ticket categories.

events.title: An Intimate Night with Erykah Badu
events.summary: Erykah Badu plays Billboard Live TOKYO on July 6 with RC Williams, in two seated stages. The Billboard Live page confirms the Tokyo date, venue, and 17:30 / 20:30 start times.

events.title: ILLIT LIVE 'PRESS START❤' in JAPAN
events.summary: ILLIT are confirmed for three Tokyo arena performances on July 23, July 25, and July 26 at TOYOTA ARENA TOKYO. The official Japan schedule lists the exact dates, doors, and start times for the PRESS START❤ run.

events.title: THE IDOLM@STER 20th Anniversary MORE RE@LITY LIVE IDOL WORLD SUPER FESTIVAL 2026
events.summary: The Idolmaster 20th-anniversary finale runs for three days at Keio Arena TOKYO from July 24 to July 26. Bandai Namco’s announcement confirms the day themes, start times, venue, and first wave of performers for the cross-franchise xR idol live.

events.title: AFRO JAM FESTIVAL TOKYO 2026
events.summary: A diaspora-focused Tokyo festival listing for Afrobeats, Afrohouse, Amapiano, Hip-Hop and R&B, positioned as a large-scale Afrobeat festival for Japan with international artists planned.

events.title: 2026 &TEAM CONCERT TOUR 'BLAZE THE WAY' in Chiba
events.summary: &TEAM’s official site confirms the Chiba stop of the 2026 BLAZE THE WAY tour at LaLa arena TOKYO-BAY on July 25 and July 26. Further performance details are marked as forthcoming on the announcement page.

events.title: JakoJako / SAMSARA EPISODE 14
events.summary: SAMSARA brings Berghain resident and modular-synth-focused techno artist JakoJako to VENT, backed by Chhabb, Mitayo, IRON and a second-room local lineup.

events.title: CHAOS
events.summary: Fumiya Tanaka’s CHAOS continues as a WWW X regular party, bringing Kyoto’s NC4K figures Stones Taro and Lomax into a techno/house-focused Tokyo night.

events.title: Steve Bug at VENT
events.summary: Poker Flat founder Steve Bug headlines VENT for a house and tech-house night, a notable touring underground booking in one of Tokyo’s core dance-music rooms.

events.title: Ken Ishii at VENT
events.summary: Tokyo techno institution Ken Ishii headlines VENT, with Room 1 and Room 2 support from local techno selectors; a high-value local-legend night rather than an arena play.

events.title: HONNE 10 YEAR ANNIVERSARY TOUR
events.summary: HONNE bring their 10 Year Anniversary Tour to SGC Hall Ariake on July 22. Creativeman confirms the Tokyo performance, with doors at 18:00 and showtime at 19:00.

events.title: The Temple of Dance
events.summary: ZEROTOKYO’s large-scale psychedelic-trance club night headlined by FADERS from Astrix’s Shamanic Tales orbit, with Rinkadink, Spectra Sonics, Xipe totecs and Japanese scene figures across rooms.

events.title: STEREOLAB Japan Tour 2026
events.summary: Stereolab play KANDA SQUARE HALL on July 1 with doors at 18:00 and showtime at 19:00. The venue page confirms the Japan tour date, location, and SMASH production credit.

events.title: Ichiko Aoba: 文月の衣紋に綴る熱帯魚
events.summary: Ichiko Aoba is confirmed for NHK Hall on July 2, opening at 18:00 and starting at 19:00. The HOT STUFF promotion page lists the date, venue, and ticket tiers.

events.title: Oyubi OPEN TO LAST -White birch burns Release Special-
events.summary: Trekkie Trax-affiliated Tokyo producer/DJ Oyubi plays open-to-close for the release of his debut album, framing footwork, ghetto tech, juke, jungle and techno as a full-night narrative.

events.title: Bluey from INCOGNITO presents "CITRUS SUN"
events.summary: Bluey’s Incognito offshoot Citrus Sun plays a four-day Blue Note Tokyo run of acid-jazz, jazz-funk, soul, Latin and groove-led live music, including a dance-space/Jazz for Children matinee on July 25.

events.title: GAEREA Live in Tokyo 2026
events.summary: Portuguese extreme-metal act GAEREA make their first Japan appearance at Daikanyama SPACE ODD on July 14. Creativeman confirms the Tokyo-only show with doors at 18:00 and start at 19:00.
